title: Repairing fire-damaged West Maui water lines
summary: On October 25, 2024, the council voted 9 to 0 to use $1.7 million in Water Fund savings for West Maui water line repairs. Meters will be returned at no cost as damaged laterals are fixed, and single-family homes that had meters before will get free ones back. A council member said misinformation about water meters is causing a big problem in the community.
